Apprenticeships are the foundation of tomorrow’s workforce—from advanced manufacturing and energy to healthcare and digital services. Talview’s Apprenticeship Assessment Solution enables employers, government bodies, and training providers to deliver secure, scalable, and skills-aligned evaluations that certify competency, strengthen employability, and accelerate national workforce development goals.
Why Talview for Apprenticeship Assessment?
Secure, AI-Powered Exam Delivery
Protect the integrity of apprenticeship certifications with Talview’s remote and in-center proctoring. Our AI-driven platform detects anomalies, prevents impersonation, and ensures fair evaluations—even at scale across geographies.
Skills-Aligned Assessment Libraries
Access a growing library of industry-specific tests mapped to apprenticeship frameworks—from the U.S. Department of Labor’s Registered Apprenticeship Programs (RAPs) to India’s NSQF standards and Europe’s EQF-aligned programs. Easily create or customize assessments for trades like advanced manufacturing, automotive technology, green energy, healthcare, and logistics.
End-to-End Assessment Management
Manage the full apprenticeship evaluation lifecycle—from entry-level screening to final certification exams. Easily schedule, monitor, and report on apprentice progress across employers, training centers, and countries.
Remote & Onsite Flexibility
Offer apprentices the choice of secure remote testing or traditional center-based exams—all within a single platform. Expand access across rural, suburban, and urban areas without compromising integrity or experience.
Real-Time Analytics & Readiness Reports
Track apprentice performance through Talview’s intuitive dashboards. Identify skill gaps, measure training outcomes, and generate instant certification readiness reports.
Seamless Integration with Training Platforms
Integrate Talview’s assessments with LMS, learning platforms, and national skills portals—creating a unified and transparent learning-to-certification journey.

Compliance with National and Regional Frameworks
United States of America (USA)
Support for U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) Registered Apprenticeship Programs (RAPs), State Apprenticeship Agencies (SAAs), and workforce development initiatives under WIOA.
India
Alignment with National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) programs, Sector Skill Councils, National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS), and National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS).
Europe
Compliance with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) principles, supporting apprenticeships under Erasmus+, national vocational education initiatives, and dual education models.
